Changes in version 0.1.9 (2026-03-31)

  • improved error messages returned by wd_getdata_syn() and wd_getdata_wwg() when errors occur

  • added wd_getdata_checks(), an internal function used to check the arguments passed to wd_getdata*()

Changes in version 0.1.8 (2025-10-28)

  • modified wd_getdata_syn() to convert NULL values returned by the API to NAs
